title: Ashbury Rewards Guidance on Hotel-Error Folio Corrections and the Elite Bonus
content:
When a Guest Folios correction removes eligible spend from a stay already credited to an Ashbury Rewards account, the reason recorded on the adjustments decides on which spend the elite bonus is taken back.

## Definitions

The removed eligible spend is the adjustments on the corrected folio posted against room, breakfast, food and beverage and spa charges. The hotel-error spend is the part of it whose adjustments carry the reason duplicate posting or incorrect rate, and the other removed spend is the rest. The bonus-bearing spend is the part of the removed eligible spend on which the elite bonus is taken back.

## Rule

The bonus-bearing spend depends on why the spend was removed: when every eligible-spend adjustment on the folio carries a hotel-error reason, the bonus-bearing spend is nothing and the elite bonus stays with the member — only base points are taken back; when the folio carries both hotel-error adjustments and other adjustments and the member holds Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite or higher, the bonus-bearing spend is the other removed spend only. Other combinations carry no different bonus-bearing spend under this guidance.

| Eligible-spend adjustments on the folio | Tier | Bonus-bearing spend |
|---|---|---|
| All carry duplicate posting or incorrect rate | any | Nothing — the elite bonus stays with the member |
| Some hotel-error, some other reasons | Gold Elite, Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | The other removed spend only |
| Some hotel-error, some other reasons | Member or Silver Elite | No different bonus-bearing spend under this guidance |
| None carries a hotel-error reason | any | No different bonus-bearing spend under this guidance |

## Cases (hypothetical folios)

| Adjustments on eligible lines | Tier | Hotel-error spend | Other removed spend | Bonus-bearing spend |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Room 180.00 duplicate posting | Silver Elite | 180.00 | 0.00 | Nothing |
| Room 180.00 duplicate posting; spa 40.00 charge not incurred | Platinum Elite | 180.00 | 40.00 | 40.00 |
| Room 60.00 incorrect rate; breakfast 25.00 charge not incurred | Silver Elite | 60.00 | 25.00 | No different spend under this guidance |
